items.title: JetBrains TeamCity experimental AI Agents plugin runs Codex and Claude Code in CI builds
facts: The new experimental AI Agents plugin for TeamCity lets you run Codex and Claude Code directly in TeamCity builds and connect them to the LLM provider of your choice.
The plugin installs the coding agent on the TeamCity build agent, provides credentials safely for the duration of the build, and collects usage statistics and agent trajectories.
Supported connections include JetBrains Air, OpenAI, Anthropic, LiteLLM, and OpenRouter.

items.title: Microsoft Research open-sources TokenEconomizer to cut AI coding agent costs by up to 30.9%
facts: TokenEconomizer is an open-source plugin that learns from an agent’s past sessions in a repository to reduce waste in future sessions, without modifying the agent or its underlying model.
Across 277 real bug-fixing tasks, TokenEconomizer reduced costs by 18.4–30.9% across multiple AI coding agents.
Costs fell in every repository tested, while task success rates remained broadly stable.

items.title: Alibaba releases Qwen4-Max with 1M context, native vision, and lower pricing for coding agents
facts: Qwen4-Max is built on a new MoE architecture with native vision and a 1M-token context window.
It outperforms Qwen3.8-Max with up to ~50% fewer tokens, while average cost per task drops over 60% in internal evaluation.
API pricing is $1.5/M tokens for input, $4.5/M tokens for output, and $0.075/M tokens for implicit caching.

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.326 enables Code Mode with agent teams and other improvements
facts: Claude Code 2.1.326 lets you use Code Mode with agent teams.
It also fixes earlier conversation history going missing when you resume a session after Claude Code ran low on memory.

items.title: GitHub Copilot adds Gemini 4 Hydrogen for fast agentic coding
facts: Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Google’s latest Flash model, is now generally available in GitHub Copilot.
It is designed for fast, efficient agentic coding, tool use, and multistep workflows, with improved instruction following over Gemini 3.8 Flash.
Available to Copilot Pro, Pro+, Max, Business, and Enterprise users, billed at provider list pricing under usage-based billing.

items.title: Gemini side panel in Google Apps Script reaches general availability for Workspace automations
facts: With the Gemini side panel in Apps Script generally available, anyone across your organization can easily create, customize, and troubleshoot scripts using plain language with no coding experience required.
Scripts run natively in Workspace with a user’s existing permissions and standard OAuth consent, while IT admins retain full visibility and control in the Admin console.
Gradual rollout (up to 15 days for feature visibility) started 12th November 2026 for Rapid Release and Scheduled Release domains.

items.title: Claude Code experimental Code Mode batches tool calls via JavaScript
facts: Added Code Mode, an experimental opt-in in which Claude writes JavaScript to call its tools.

Without Code Mode, Claude asks for tool calls such as Bash, Read, or Edit directly and reads each result before it decides what to do next. With Code Mode, Claude writes a piece of JavaScript that makes the tool calls, and Claude Code runs that code in your session.

items.title: Hermes Agent leads OpenRouter daily rankings with long-term memory via Honcho plugin
facts: On OpenRouter's own daily app ranking, Hermes Agent processed 1.71T tokens. Kilo Code was second with 1.21T, and Claude Code third with 1.17T. The figures were checked on Nov 16, 2026.
Honcho is an open-source memory layer for AI agents that works with Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and more.
